text: Film or DGS number, archive and image numbers for the Folder 1 pages, to settle H-010.
The image or citation behind the 1869 census find, to settle H-007.
The full register page for the Mihály Demkó entry, with its header, to settle H-015 and confirm the column headings.
What led the owner to the Belža Greek Catholic book, and the full pages with their title, to settle H-018.
Baptisms of Demko children at Viszoka from 1857 to 1873 and from 1883 to 1895, if the owner has them, and any entry for a Maria Demko. Settles H-022, H-023.
The full page for the 1872 entry labelled Anna Demko (D-004-01), to see the note cut off above it.
Michal Duska's own baptism entry (Senné, Roman Catholic, about 1895 to 1908) and his marriage to Maria Demko (about 1925 to 1929). Settles H-027, H-030.

A second image of the 1877 entry for Szenna 72, or other entries naming the same family, to settle the spelling (H-026). Withdrawn at B-013: settled by comparison with another entry by the same clerk.
Baptisms of Duska children in the Senné Roman Catholic register, 1890 to 1910, and any Duska marriage of 1865 to 1900. Settles H-030, H-035, H-036.

The full row, and the rows below it, for Mihály Duska of 'Bradenville' on the page of the December [1902] baptisms at Solymos (D-007-08), and the certificate or extract it cites. The strip cuts the row in half. It would settle the place, the mother's surname and the date, and so test H-040.

The Reformed marriage and burial registers for Solymos, 1860 to 1910, if the owner has pages from them: to name the fathers of János Dusko and Mihály Dusko (H-042) and to see which of the boys named Mihály lived (H-040, H-041).
